description: Build a JSON config parser module with `load_config(json_str)` that parses JSON and returns a dict, `get_value(config, key, default=None)` that safely gets a nested value using dot notation (e.g. 'a.b.c'), and `merge_configs(base, override)` that deep-merges two dicts. Test all three functions.
